title: Do Embedding-Map Distances Guide LLM Ideation? Four Tests Against What Came Next
abstract: arXiv:2611.21408v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A popular ideation recipe treats an embedding map of existing work as a guide: pick points far from everything and decode them into ideas. I test four ways such distances could guide ideation against what appeared later. (1) Far random directions are not text: no later item reaches a raw cosine above about 0.10 with one (after centring or whitening, 22 of 24 cells stay out of reach), and an LLM decoder shown a target's neighbours, with score-only feedback, writes those neighbours in all six target sets. A neighbour-free search writes coherent text at median cosine 0.57 and 0.47 to interior gaps, beating the nearest existing item on 15 and 14 of 20, but only 0.07 and 0.06 to far points. (2) On k-means cells of a past-only map, the registered hole score mostly tracks cell size and position; three density-based gap scores forecast which cells grow fastest at or below chance (AUC 0.30 to 0.66) and add nothing to momentum in Steam and arXiv

translated_title: 嵌入图距离能引导大语言模型的构思吗？针对后续发展的四项检验
translated_abstract: 一种流行的构思配方将现有工作的嵌入图视为指南：选择远离所有现有点的位置，并将其解码为创意。我针对后来实际出现的内容，检验了这类距离引导构思的四种方式。(1) 远处的随机方向并非文本：没有后续条目与它们的原始余弦相似度超过约0.10（经过中心化或白化处理后，24个单元格中有22个仍然无法企及），而且当仅以分数作为反馈、向LLM解码器展示目标点的邻近文献时，它在全部六个目标集合中都直接写出了这些邻近内容。一种不含邻居信息的搜索在与内部空白区域的中位数余弦相似度0.57和0.47处写出连贯文本，在20个案例中分别有15个和14个超过最近的现有条目，但与远点的相似度仅为0.07和0.06。(2) 在仅基于过去数据构建的地图的k-means单元格上，登记的空洞得分主要追踪的是单元格的大小和位置；三种基于密度的空白得分预测哪些单元格增长最快的能力处于机会水平或更低（AUC为0.30至0.66），并且在Steam和arXiv数据上对动量没有附加预测贡献。
tldr: 本文通过对后续实际出现内容的四项检验，证明嵌入图中远离现有工作的距离并不能引导LLM进行真正新颖的构思——远点方向无法解码为真实文本、LLM倾向于复述邻近已知工作、基于密度的空白得分预测未来增长的能力不超过随机水平。
en_tdlr: Through four tests against what actually appeared later, this paper shows that distances in embedding maps do not guide genuinely novel LLM ideation—far random directions cannot be decoded into real text, LLM decoders merely reproduce neighboring known works, and density-based gap scores forecast future growth at or below chance level.
